result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, serving a mix of residential and commercial land uses. However, the environment lacks marked mid-block crossings and traffic calming measures, while on-street parking creates potential visual obstructions between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles
hazards.description: High-density on-street parking obscures sightlines for pedestrians attempting to cross the street mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Wide, straight roadway
hazards.description: The lack of traffic calming on a long, straight stretch of road likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes extending into the distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point between intersections.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or other vertical deflection to manage vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

result.summary: The environment features a two-lane roadway with sidewalks that are significantly obstructed by vehicles parked directly on the pedestrian walkway. A wide, unmarked side street or driveway entrance creates a large, unprotected crossing area with poor visibility for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked on the sidewalk area in front of the commercial building, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, in front of the brick building

hazards.name: Unmarked Wide Crossing
hazards.description: A wide side street or driveway lacks any pedestrian markings or traffic control, creating a long, exposed crossing distance.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the junction

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across the side street to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Physical Parking Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or planters along the sidewalk edge to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian walkway.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with sidewalks on both sides, serving a mix of commercial and residential land uses. The environment lacks pedestrian-oriented infrastructure such as marked crossings or traffic calming, and the wide roadway geometry likely encourages higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide travel lanes
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway and multiple travel lanes encourage high vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian exposure during crossing.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly within the narrow sidewalk path, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of midblock crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points for a long stretch of the block, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected or walk long distances to intersections.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at intersections and potential midblock crossings to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking a dedicated sidewalk or any physical separation between people and vehicles. Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or through a parking area, with parked cars creating significant visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no designated walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to share space with moving and parked vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire length of the street edge in front of the wall.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles block sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: The row of cars parked along the yellow wall.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during night hours.
